articles.description: Ross Newhan, who earned Hall of Fame honors after decades covering pro baseball for the L.A. Times, was honored by the Dodgers and MLB after his death.
articles.title: Appreciation: Ross Newhan, Hall of Fame baseball writer for The Times, dies at 89

articles.description: Aaron Bates spent 12 years in the Dodgers organization, including four as a co-hitting coach with Robert Van Scoyoc, and four as an assistant hitting coach.
articles.title: ‘Things run their course.’ Dodgers and hitting coach Aaron Bates part ways

articles.description: The Dodgers are hiring former San Diego Padres executive Caroline Perry as their executive vice president and chief operating officer.
articles.title: Dodgers adding former Padres executive to their front office
